purpose: Publication table evidence curated from the latest corrected figure source data, not the superseded 20260909 evidence package.
selection_guidance: Ten recommended rows cover each main evidentiary stage and include the unseen-compound confirmation boundary. Keep post hoc conditional-versus-joint comparison and downstream negative results explicitly qualified in supplementary tables; include an optional boundary row in the main table if space permits.

derived_interval_inventory.explanation: Three cpg0004 CP budget intervals plus five unique GE-target contrasts in Figure 3. Conditional-minus-target-only appears twice (Figure 3b/3c) with exactly the same interval, creating six CSV rows for five unique contrasts.

metric_rules: Do not compare effect sizes across PCC, Fisher z, fraction overlap, sign agreement, trajectory Spearman, AP and mAP as a common unit.
Figure 2b/c, Figure 3 and Figure 4a paired fixed-null contrasts are changes in repeat/module agreement, not prediction-specific perturbation specificity.
Figure 2d/e and sci-Plex3 transfer retain their prediction-specific perturbation-specificity definitions.
Morphology macro means seven feature groups including Cross-channel; the six displayed structural groups are not the macro denominator.
n counts compounds/drugs, not seed rows, rotations, plate pairs, or summed repeated target sets.
Original published rounded values are retained when those are the available reported results; do not add false decimals to the GE-to-CP 0.02150 report.
